_changelog.reason: Systemic classifier fix (pkg/quality/unhomedlogic/check.go): added `KEEP-CI-WIRED` to homedMarkers alongside `KEEP-OPERATOR` + `KEEP-CI-ORCHESTRATOR`. KEEP-CI-WIRED is the marker used by every canonical hermetic guard shipped since 2026-05 (all `infra/tests/check-*-syntax_test.sh` pairs); it is functionally equivalent to KEEP-CI-ORCHESTRATOR (the script IS the CI gate — pure grep on source, zero network, zero kubectl). Pre-fix the classifier misclassified 117 legitimate CI-wired guards as UNHOMED, driving the test-domain count from 121→146 across Red Team sprints 6-9 and blocking PRs on the un-homed-logic gate. Post-fix: 117 scripts flipped UNHOMED→HOMED and the true un-homed count for the tree is 82 (drop-in ratchet-down; future drift now caught at a much tighter floor). Companion refactors: `infra/tests/helm/tilt-secret-keys-classification_test.sh` (Python-heredoc→yq for YAML parsing) + `infra/tests/check-baseline-diff_test.sh` (5 Python-heredoc fixture builders→jq) — both flagged as suspect-KEEP by the anti-bias content-check when their KEEP-CI-WIRED marker was recognized as HOMED (the classifier working as intended — Python-in-bash is reimplementable and now expressed with native JSON/YAML tools instead). Test suite `pkg/quality/unhomedlogic/`: 10/10 GREEN post-fix (1 new RED→GREEN assertion verifies KEEP-CI-WIRED classifies HOMED). Gate `loopzero-ops quality unhomed-logic --check` now exits 0.
